verdict.rationale: Lorikeet Coach is documented as providing in-product AI insights and suggestions from customer conversation data. It reviews 100% of tickets, offers conversational insights and analytics, makes improvement suggestions or implements them itself, and can be used inside Lorikeet; knowledge-base audits and simulation replays also surface gaps. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how Coach's insights are generated and presented, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Scale and optimize with conversational insights and analytics from Lorikeet Coach
Coach can implement improvements on your behalf, or make suggestions for you to action yourself.
Coach reviews 100% of tickets against your quality standards and turns findings into fixes
Talk to Coach wherever you work, whether in Lorikeet, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, or via MCP.
Audit your entire knowledge base for gaps, outdated articles, and quality issues
